input.targets: Both original scalar and raised occupied-line mixed-medium targets, unchanged

deformation.choice: All uncut physical quadratic denominators shifted by common +eta in Euclidean convention, -eta in native convention, subject to full region audit
deformation.fixed: physical cut shells, positive-energy support, occupation regions, physical-point inverse-propagator target indices and coefficients
deformation.physical_raising: Independent physical masses differentiated at fixed original momentum polynomial and chemical potentials, including conversion coefficient and Fermi-surface derivatives

coefficient_budget.cap_excludes: internal CAS scratch and one indivisible operation; external process time limit remains mandatory

reconstruction_budget.selection: deterministic training-only; freeze candidate and hash before holdout access; no tuning using holdout or numerical references
reconstruction_budget.certificate: Exact all-index recurrence identity or telescoping/other analytic identity for the integrated kernel, with every boundary term; finite agreement alone is insufficient

transport_budget.fallback: Assess direct continuation of exactly the same integrated coefficients with explicit truncation/error control; Pade agreement alone is not a bound; no auxiliary occupation-aware closure

sources.role: AMF with phase-space integration; not a proof of fixed independent occupied-domain closure
Holonomic integration needs a telescoper/certificate and boundary terms
